title: Two-seed connected versus detached preflop actor geometric learned-weight trial
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Allowing current preflop actor objectives to adapt shared representation may improve replicated learning breadth relative to the retained detached-feature control, without changing critic routing or initial inference.
material_change: Same frozen candidate runtime and original-LR parents; connected arm alone enables preflop actor-to-trunk gradients. Two seeds at262k and1M added physical hands per arm, matched fresh multi-anchor evaluation.
